title: Mail templates
subtitle: Write email templates with variables, send them to Clients or a recipient list, and track delivery.
empty: There are no mail templates yet.
error: Could not load the mail templates.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this template?
confirmDelete.body: "{{name}}" will be deleted. Past send history is kept.

form.name: Template name
form.subject: Email subject
form.bodyPlaceholder: Write the email. Insert variables such as {{name}} to personalize.
form.variablesHint: Use {{variable_name}} to personalize. workspaceName and senderName are filled in by the system.
form.attachmentRules: PDF, images, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX. Up to 3 files, 5MB each, 10MB in total.

send.title: Send email
send.description: Choose recipients, fill the variables, preview, then send now or schedule.
send.agencyRecipients: Recipients are determined automatically from the agency when you send.
send.recipientsHelp: Paste emails or a CSV with an email column (other columns become variables). Up to {{max}} recipients.
send.scheduleHelp: Between 5 minutes and 30 days from now. Leave empty to send now.
send.quotaExceeded: over the daily limit: schedule it or reduce recipients
send.testSent: A test email was sent to your inbox.

blocked.noRecipients: Add at least one valid recipient to send.
blocked.tooMany: Too many recipients in one send. Split the list.
blocked.variables: Fill in every shared variable above to send.
blocked.quota: Today's sending quota is not enough. Schedule for later or reduce recipients.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe from emails
unsubscribe.done: You have been unsubscribed. You will not receive more emails from this sender.
unsubscribe.invalid: This link is invalid or has been modified.

picker.title: Choose a system mail template
picker.hint: Only the subject and text are copied. Replace the {{…}} variables before sending.

admin.title: System mail templates
admin.description: Shared library: Workspaces can clone them and Admins use them when composing notifications.
admin.batchesDescription: Progress of admin broadcasts and agency mail. Cancel a scheduled batch or resend the failed ones.
admin.suppressionsDescription: Everyone who unsubscribed from admin broadcasts. Re-subscribing is recorded in the audit log.

errors.generic: Something went wrong, please try again.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Please enter a valid name, subject and content.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.SYSTEM_TEMPLATE_READ_ONLY: System templates can only be cloned.
errors.MAIL_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Daily sending limit exceeded. Schedule the send or reduce recipients.
errors.MAIL_SCHEDULE_OUT_OF_RANGE: The schedule must be between 5 minutes and 30 days from now.
errors.MAIL_BATCH_NOT_CANCELLABLE: Only a scheduled send that has not started can be cancelled.
errors.EMAIL_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The email service is unavailable, please retry.
errors.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: You are doing that too fast, please retry later.
errors.MAIL_BATCH_NOT_RESENDABLE: Only finished batches with failed emails can be resent.
errors.MAIL_GROUP_LIMIT_REACHED: Too many saved groups. Delete one first.

preview.title: Preview
preview.sample: Sample values are used for variables; real values are filled in when you send.

variables.didYouMean: {{name}} is not a known variable. Did you mean {{suggestion}}?
variables.malformed: Some braces do not form a valid {{variable}}. Variables look like {{name}} with no spaces.

draft.kept: Draft saved. You can continue it next time.

suppressions.loadFailed: Could not load the unsubscribed list.
suppressions.forbidden: You are not allowed to see this list.
suppressions.title: Unsubscribed addresses
suppressions.subtitle: People who unsubscribed from this Workspace's emails. They are skipped when you send.
suppressions.agencySubtitle: People who unsubscribed from this agency's emails. They are skipped when you send. Re-subscribing is recorded in the audit log.

agency.title: Agency mail templates
agency.description: Compose emails for your agency members or partner clients with the block builder.

builder.empty: Drag a block here or click a block on the left to start.
builder.legacy: This template was written as free-form HTML. Build it again with blocks to save changes.

errors.imageRequired: Image URL and alt text are required.
errors.urlHttp: URL must start with http:// or https://.

broadcast.title: Send "{{name}}" to all users
broadcast.description: This sends the notice to every active user. Recipients are resolved by the system when you send.
broadcast.passwordRequired: This broadcast is large. Enter your password to confirm.

audience.failed: Could not load the recipient list.
